Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood inference POC (time options)

John — really appreciate the flexibility and the head's-up on availability. Short answer: we can support an exec-friendly slot, but we want to avoid waking our core EU engineering team at 05:00 CET if we can help it. Two pragmatic options that have worked for us with similar customers: 

1) Live exec demo at 8:00pm PT (45m) delivered by our US-based Solutions Architect + Rishi (me) for the CRO audience; we record the session. Then schedule a follow-up deep-dive (30–60m) the next morning UK/CEST time with our EU engineers for technical Q&A.

2) Move the live session to 10:00am PT (19:00 CEST) on Fri 4 Jun so both execs and EU engineers can attend synchronously. I know that may not work for your execs.

If the preference is to keep 8pm PT on Thu, we'll do option (1). I've attached a 1-page agenda and a high-level network diagram for your security team to scan. Monica — can your team be on stand-by for the recorded session to jump into the Q&A if there are late technical asks?

Proposed agenda (45m):
- 0–10m: Exec overview & value props (Rishi)
- 10–30m: Live demo — Redwood API + cost/latency dashboard (Solutions Architect)
- 30–40m: High-level rollout/attestation & security controls (Laura)
- 40–45m: Next steps / scheduling deep-dive (everyone)

If you prefer, here's a Calendly link to pick an alternate slot: https://cal.com/rishi/demo-45m

Would you like us to lock option (1) for Thu 3 Jun 8:00pm PT and record, or should I send a separate invite for Fri 10:00am PT?

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415 555 2200
